title: I SIT
skill_description: Recognize and name target letters M, S, A, T, O, I. Distinguish letter shapes.
author: FunBookies
summary: A simple label book where the reader practices recognizing sight words A and I with basic actions.
targetPhonics: Letters M, S, A, T, O, I - letter recognition and sight words A, I

reference_prompt:
A 9-panel reference sheet for children's book illustration style.
Style: Simple bold shapes, soft watercolor, very minimal detail, warm pastel colors, toddler-friendly illustration
Mood: gentle, comforting, bright

The 9 panels arranged in a 3x3 grid showing:
Panel 1: A happy child sitting on a colorful mat. Simple, warm illustration.
Panel 2: Words to Know
Panel 3: A child sitting on the floor with legs crossed.
Panel 4: A child who has just sat down on a chair.
Panel 5: A colorful mat on the floor.
Panel 6: A child sitting on the mat.
Panel 7: A different patterned mat.
Panel 8: A child sitting happily on the new mat.
Panel 9: A child sitting contentedly, smiling.

Consistent art style across all panels, suitable for children's picture book illustration. Each panel is a square vignette showing a key moment or character.

IMPORTANT: Minimize text in panels. Focus on visual style, characters, colors, and mood. No title text.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Point to pictures and ask: What do you see? This book helps practice reading skills.
parent_tips.during_reading: Point to each word as you read. Encourage your child to find pictures that match the words.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: What happened in the story? Can you find your favorite picture?
